tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bla ma dam pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs// 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*// me shel med par me mi 'byung*// de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur// des na khyod ni mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter// dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud// khyod ni gdul bya smin bya'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston// spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel// byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams// mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs// gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu// dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston// nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po khyed kyis mkhyen// thams cad spros pa'i phrin las kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul// gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba yis// sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang*// bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa// khyod kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rmad// gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pa// de la de ma thag byin rlobs// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub// des na rdo rje slob dpon mchog

/dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud// rnam pa kun du bdag skyabs mchi// phyi dang gsang ba de kho na// lus dang longs spyod 'brel pa dang*// srog gi bar gyis khyod mnyes bgyi// ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa// bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob par// de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las// ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do// khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid bsgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rnam pa kun du khyod bsten no// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub slad du// mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na// gal te bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang de dor te// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// khyod mnyes bgyid pa'ang bsgrub par shog /bla ma dam pa la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rten cing 'brel pa 'byung ba'i sgo nas bstod pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba'o// gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur phyin ci ma log par thob pa'i gang zag gis/ tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas bla ma la gsol ba btab na/ tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po thob par 'gyur ro// dbang bskur ba yang dag par ma thob pa'i gang zag gis bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba gdab par ma mthong ngo*// dbang bskur ba yang dag par thob nas bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas bstod na/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bstod par 'gyur bas rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
